nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address; assigned from msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
GoldInu.symbol token ticker, set to 'GODI' in the constructor.
GoldInu.name token name, set to 'GoldInu' in the constructor.
GoldInu.decimals token precision, set to 18.
GoldInu._totalSupply total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
GoldInu mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances written by transfer/transferFrom and the constructor.
GoldInu nested mapping of owner to spender allowances written by approve and approveAndCall.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure, returns a+b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure, returns a-b with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure, returns a*b with division-based overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure, returns a/b with require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, granting unrestricted privileged control.
Owned.transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner: stages a new owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then moves ownership and clears newOwner.
GoldInu() constructor: initializes symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
GoldInu.totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked arithmetic.
GoldInu.balanceOf(address) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner].
GoldInu.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits 'to' via safeSub/safeAdd, emits Transfer.
GoldInu.approve(address spender, uint tokens): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender], emits Approval.
GoldInu.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balances and decrements the caller's allowance using safeSub/safeAdd.
GoldInu.allowance(address,address) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
GoldInu.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance, emits Approval and then calls spender.receiveApproval, an external call to an attacker-controlled contract.
GoldInu fallback function: payable but immediately reverts, rejecting all plain ETH transfers.
GoldInu.transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint) onlyOwner: performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call on an owner-supplied address.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance debiting and allowance bookkeeping.
Raw addition c = a + b inside safeAdd; overflow-guarded by require(c >= a).
Raw subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub; underflow-guarded by require(b <= a).
Raw multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul; overflow-guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Raw division c = a / b inside safeDiv; guarded by require(b > 0).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply(), not routed through SafeMath.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary untrusted contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary owner-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, creating the privileged role.
Untrusted msg.sender becomes the contract owner.
Constructor consumes msg.sender to initialize owner.
onlyOwner function stages the pending owner in newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier compares untrusted msg.sender against owner.
onlyOwner guard on transferAnyERC20Token checks untrusted msg.sender against owner.
acceptOwnership moves the owner role to the accepted account.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) gates the ownership handover on caller identity.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Constructor initializes symbol.
Constructor initializes name.
Constructor initializes decimals.
Constructor mints the fixed total supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the entire supply to the hardcoded deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction on supply and burned-balance values.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
transfer debits the caller balance and credits the recipient balance.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
approve writes the allowance mapping for the caller and spender.
transferFrom mutates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in allowed.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before making the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an untrusted spender contract, allowing reentrant callbacks.

approve stores an allowance keyed by untrusted msg.sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender both as the allowance owner and as the callback argument.
